features.method: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim relation 18896697 (landuse=commercial, name 'Brookhaven National Laboratory'), a MultiPolygon of 2 outer rings (79 + 17 nodes), used verbatim as the campus fence/boundary. Fetched via the Nominatim API (nominatim.openstreetmap.org), not Overpass: both permitted Overpass mirrors were unreachable for the rest of this session after the initial BNL extraction (see worklog); Nominatim reads the same underlying OSM database and returns full relation geometry via 'polygon_geojson=1'. Both the RHIC ring (geometry:bnl-rhic-ring) and the AGS ring (geometry:bnl-ags-ring) centroids fall inside this boundary's bounding box, a consistency check against the two independently-fetched shapes.

summary.plain: Brookhaven National Laboratory's main campus in Upton, New York: the 3.8-km RHIC ring with the STAR and PHENIX/sPHENIX detector halls at two of its interaction points, the older 807-m AGS ring that now injects into RHIC, and nearby accelerator buildings, drawn to scale from OpenStreetMap and BNL's own published figures.
